overall_notes: The paper focuses on multimodal sequential compositional generalization, evaluating both language generation (next utterance prediction) and structured prediction (atom classification) tasks. The extraction was generally accurate but missed several baseline models and the atom classification task. The paper uses thorough automatic evaluation but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluations.
